name: sobinpay-monorepo
description: Enterprise-grade multi-provider payment gateway SDK for Cambodia by Sobin Digital

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@sobin/core && npm run build --workspace=@sobin/provider-khqr && npm run build --workspace=@sobin/provider-payway && npm run build --workspace=@sobin/pay
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=playground
scripts.publish:packages: npm run build:packages && npm publish --workspace=@sobin/core --access public && npm publish --workspace=@sobin/provider-khqr --access public && npm publish --workspace=@sobin/provider-payway --access public && npm publish --workspace=@sobin/pay --access public

author: Sobin Digital
